entry.title: New: dsh-input-traffic
entry.summary: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with freeze/resume and in-place multi-line editing. Exact install spec: dsh-input-traffic. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
